# `response-error-status-removed`

4xx/5xx response removed

| | |
|---|---|
| **Kind** | `wire` |
| **Default severity** | `info` |
| **Rule IDs** | `response-error-status-removed` |
| **Status** | Implemented (M3) |
| **Group** | Responses ([RULES.md section 6](../../RULES.md)) |

## What it detects

A documented 4xx or 5xx response was removed.

## Why this default

Clients that handle it keep working; the server just stops returning it (or stops documenting it).

## Example

From test case [`response-error-status-removed`](../../test/cases/response-error-status-removed/): A documented 404 removed.

`openapi.yaml`, base → revision:

```diff
  …
                schema:
                  type: object
-         '404':
-           description: not found
```

Findings:

- `response-error-status-removed` · info · GET /pets

## Test cases

The example above is the only test case for this rule.


## Policy options

Every rule takes `severity` (`error`, `warn`, `info` or `off`), `fix` and `explanation` in the policy file. The policy file arrives in M6; see [POLICY.md](../../POLICY.md).

```yaml
rules:
  response-error-status-removed: info
```

## How to fix

Nothing to fix; check that the server really stopped returning it.
